title: Irish Cream Cake
description: A moist and creamy cake with a hint of Irish whiskey, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.notes: for a rich and creamy texture

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease two 9-inch round cake pans.
Prepare the cake mix according to the package instructions.
Add the irish cream, heavy cream, eggs, sugar, butter, and vanilla extract to the cake mix. Mix until well combined.
Pour the batter evenly into the prepared pans.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove the cakes from the oven and let them cool in the pans for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cakes are completely cool, you can frost and decorate them as desired.
